paraphrase_notes: Package 15 synthesizes current employer, municipal and union evidence that entry-level stagehand work spans load-in, show/performance support, load-out and related production tasks.
applicability_notes: Exact call shape and assignments vary by employer, production, sector and local practice.
required_qualifier: Treat phases and duties as recurring patterns, not one universal call structure.

paraphrase_notes: Operational packet supports a recurring check-in-to-release work rhythm across multiple local sources.
applicability_notes: One local or contract must not be generalized nationally.
required_qualifier: Call-specific employer/local/venue rules control exact workflow.

paraphrase_notes: Package 17 supports recognition, avoidance, reporting and escalation around jobsite hazards and controlled equipment, while preserving equipment-specific authority rules.
applicability_notes: No single OSHA rule creates one universal prohibition for every theatrical machine or system.
required_qualifier: Apply the actual equipment-specific training/authorization and site process.

paraphrase_notes: Directly supports training/evaluation requirements for covered powered industrial truck operators; corroborates the general beginner boundary against self-operating controlled equipment.
applicability_notes: Limited to powered industrial trucks within the standard; not a universal rule for all event equipment.
required_qualifier: Use this source only for covered powered industrial trucks.

paraphrase_notes: Package 16 supports hazard-selected PPE, context-dependent readiness and the separation of show blacks from PPE.
applicability_notes: Internal synthesis; exact legal PPE claims are separately linked to OSHA sources in qualified claim records.
required_qualifier: Task/site hazard assessment and employer requirements control actual PPE.

paraphrase_notes: Hazard assessment, PPE selection/communication and training support the module's context-dependent PPE framing.
applicability_notes: General-industry Subpart I context where applicable.
required_qualifier: Employer/site hazard assessment controls actual PPE selection.

support_locator: jobsite hazard and equipment traffic sections
paraphrase_notes: Supports orienting to equipment traffic, walking surfaces, outdoor/site conditions and controlled work zones.
applicability_notes: Venue and event conditions vary materially.
required_qualifier: Follow the actual site plan and equipment-control process.

paraphrase_notes: Supports safe walking-working surfaces, access and hazard correction/guarding as part of site orientation.
applicability_notes: Does not establish public-event accessibility acceptance.
required_qualifier: Separate public accessibility/fire/AHJ requirements may also apply.

paraphrase_notes: Pedestrian traffic, ramps and workplace conditions are recognized powered-industrial-truck training concerns; supports treating workers as pedestrians in equipment operating environments.
applicability_notes: Powered industrial truck context only.
required_qualifier: Do not generalize to every powered device.

paraphrase_notes: Supports assignment ownership, report-back, handoff and return to the established source of work rather than self-assignment.
applicability_notes: Exact steward/head/lead hierarchy varies by call.
required_qualifier: Use the controlling call's actual chain of command.

support_locator: reporting, assignment and department work rules
paraphrase_notes: Provides a current local example of steward/department assignment and remaining with assigned work.
applicability_notes: Local 101 is not a national rule.
required_qualifier: Present as local evidence supporting a broader cross-source pattern.

paraphrase_notes: Synthesizes employer/municipal/union evidence for unloading, cases/equipment movement, staging/riser/scenic support, distribution and cable-related assigned tasks during load-in.
applicability_notes: Exact beginner assignments vary by production and department.
required_qualifier: Do not treat the listed duties as a guaranteed sequence on every call.

paraphrase_notes: Supports clear material-handling aisles/passageways and stable storage as safety constraints on material flow.
applicability_notes: Does not define live-event department workflow.
required_qualifier: Use as workplace-material-handling baseline only.

paraphrase_notes: Supports tool/cable/material handling as normal early-career knowledge and distinguishes professional technique from regulation.
applicability_notes: Tool expectations vary by assignment/local/employer.
required_qualifier: Do not present one universal stagehand tool kit or universal tool-use authority.

paraphrase_notes: Supports employer responsibility for safe condition of covered tools/equipment; does not authorize an unfamiliar worker to operate them.
applicability_notes: Covered hand/portable powered tools in general-industry scope.
required_qualifier: Specific operation still requires task/equipment competence and employer authorization where applicable.

paraphrase_notes: Supports strike, packing, movement and reloading as load-out work while explicitly rejecting a universal national ranking of load-out as categorically more hazardous than load-in.
applicability_notes: Risk factors vary by call, schedule, environment and task.
required_qualifier: Do not state that load-out is universally more dangerous than load-in.

paraphrase_notes: Supports separating task completion, department release, call release and timekeeping/sign-out.
applicability_notes: Local/CBA/employer procedures vary.
required_qualifier: Actual release/timekeeping process is call-specific.

paraphrase_notes: Provides federal wage/hour context showing that waiting, short rest periods and bona fide meal periods are legally distinct concepts for covered employment relationships.
applicability_notes: Worker classification, state/local law, CBA and facts matter; not a universal stagehand break rule.
required_qualifier: Use only as federal educational context for covered employment relationships.

paraphrase_notes: Supports distinguishing general awareness/support from equipment-specific training and authorization.
applicability_notes: Different controlled systems use different legal, employer, manufacturer, union and credential mechanisms.
required_qualifier: Do not collapse awareness, training, authorization and qualification into one state.

paraphrase_notes: Authenticity audit supports retaining explicit beginner boundaries and avoiding implied credentials/authorization.
applicability_notes: Internal synthesis; external gates remain controlled by their actual authorities.
required_qualifier: Crew Blueprint does not confer A3–A5 authority states.

paraphrase_notes: Supports multiple hiring channels and recurring reliability/punctuality/professionalism/safety expectations while rejecting one national entry or callback system.
applicability_notes: Hiring and referral systems vary by employer/local/market.
required_qualifier: No universal national callback score or single entry route.

paraphrase_notes: Demonstrates real onboarding/development structures while confirming they are not standardized to one 30-day model.
applicability_notes: Local/institution examples only.
required_qualifier: Crew Blueprint's early-call sequence is internal instructional framing.
